name: Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated
summary: Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated provides consulting services for various industries in Japan. It offers logistics services, including consulting, trading, and transportation; management consulting, marketing and executive training, financial advisory, and digital marketing services; and digital solutions. The company was formerly known as Funai Consulting Incorporated and changed its name to Funai Soken Holdings Incorporated in July 2014. The company was incorporated in 1970 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
